arStrings.szText: You've acquired a piece of {icon:Icon_Tooltip_Chaos,2.5.} {c_unique}Chaos Armor{/c}. Warped by demonic influence, its power is stronger than other {c_unique}Unique Items{/c}.
{icon:Icon_Tooltip_Chaos,2.5.} {c_unique}Chaos Armor{/c} ignores ordinary equipment rules. They can drop in any Armor slot: Helm, Chest, Gloves, Legs, or Boots.

Discover more {icon:Icon_Tooltip_Chaos,2.5.} {c_unique}Chaos Armor{/c} by defeating {c_highlight}Bartuc, Lord of Chaos{/c} in {icon:Icon_Tooltip_Marker_BSK_Entrance,2.} {c_highlight}Infernal Hordes{/c}.
